name: @flop-tools/conformance-lab
description: Cross-system conformance testing for FLOP, TCLK, Technocore and routing implementations.

scripts.build: node tools/clean-build.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/copy-assets.js
scripts.quickstart: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js verify --profile technocore-agent --input examples/external-consumer/technocore-agent.json --out conformance-report.json
scripts.drift:snapshot: npm run build && node dist/src/drift-cli.js snapshot --previous conformance/observatory/baseline.json --out conformance/observatory/current.json --events conformance/observatory/events.json
scripts.evolution:update: npm run build && node dist/src/protocol-evolution-cli.js --handoff conformance/observatory/handoff.json --out conformance/observatory/evolution-history.json
scripts.check: npm run adoption:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run conformance && npm run pack:check && npm run package:smoke
scripts.interactions:snapshot: npm run build && node dist/src/interaction-cli.js snapshot --previous conformance/interactions/state.json --out conformance/interactions/current.json --events conformance/interactions/events.json
scripts.runtime:f1: npm run build && node dist/src/runtime-cli.js run --target reference-f1 --input examples/external-consumer/direct-rail-f1.json --previous .runtime/reference-f1-latest.json --out .runtime/reference-f1-latest.json
scripts.runtime:cycle: npm run build && node dist/src/runtime-cli.js cycle --target reference-f1 --input examples/external-consumer/direct-rail-f1.json --state .runtime/reference-f1-state.json --retry-budget 2 --history-limit 744
scripts.runtime:status: npm run build && node dist/src/runtime-status-cli.js --root .runtime --json runtime-public/runtime-index.json --markdown runtime-public/STATUS.md
scripts.longitudinal:sync: npm run build && node dist/src/longitudinal-cli.js sync
scripts.runtime:proof-api:f1: npm run build && node dist/src/runtime-cli.js run --target external-flop-proof-api-f1 --input examples/external-consumer/direct-rail-f1.json --out .runtime/external-flop-proof-api-f1-latest.json
scripts.runtime:task-relay:paper: npm run build && node dist/src/runtime-cli.js run --target external-task-relay-paper --input examples/external-consumer/task-relay-paper.json --out .runtime/external-task-relay-paper-latest.json
scripts.runtime:task-relay:cycle: npm run build && node dist/src/runtime-cli.js cycle --target external-task-relay-paper --input examples/external-consumer/task-relay-paper.json --state .runtime/external-task-relay-paper-state.json --retry-budget 1 --history-limit 744
scripts.runtime:deal-scout:cycle: npm run build && node dist/src/runtime-cli.js cycle --target external-deal-scout --input examples/external-consumer/deal-scout-readonly.json --state .runtime/external-deal-scout-state.json --retry-budget 1 --history-limit 744
